say:2:1122202001:1.text: Chippy's here to do an inspection on the base's improvements!
say:2:1122202001:1.source_cn: 最近基地发展得怎么样？我们是来检查的！

say:3:1122202002:1.text: C'mon, what do you take me for? Of course it's improved tons! But you've actually timed your visit perfectly.
say:3:1122202002:1.source_cn: 有我在，用不着担心那么多。

say:4:1122202003:1.text: Remember that bounty from the Buckthorn Caravan? It's time to start digging into that and begin our second round of training!
say:4:1122202003:1.source_cn: 不过你们来得正好，还记得红沙棘商队的悬赏吧？是时候开始...

choice_prompt:5:1122202003.text: Remember that bounty from the Buckthorn Caravan? It's time to start digging into that and begin our second round of training!
choice_prompt:5:1122202003.source_cn: 不过你们来得正好，还记得红沙棘商队的悬赏吧？是时候开始调查，顺便进行第二次训练了。

say:6:1122202004:1.text: Of course! A bounty hunter's always gotta stay on their toes.
say:6:1122202004:1.source_cn: 当然！赏金猎人的差事可不是那么容易做的。

say:7:1122202007:1.text: Anyways, today's training is all about a crucial skill. Gathering intel!
say:7:1122202007:1.source_cn: 今天要训练的是一项必须掌握的技能——获取情报。

say:8:1122202008:1.text: Isn't that just when you go around and chat with people...?
say:8:1122202008:1.source_cn: 说得很厉害，实际上不就是到处和人聊天嘛……

say:9:1122202009:1.text: Hmph, don't underestimate just how tough this job can be.
say:9:1122202009:1.source_cn: 哼，你可别小瞧了这份工作的难度。

say:11:1122202010:1.text: Gathering intel is just the beginning. Figuring out what's true, piecing it all together, and finding informants is the real challenge!
say:11:1122202010:1.source_cn: 搜集情报只是最简单的一环，辨别真伪、汇总推断，还有拉拢...

say:12:1122202011:1.text: There are no shortcuts to mastering this skill, it just takes experience. Even after all these years I've been in the Eroded Enclave, building my own network hasn't been easy.
say:12:1122202011:1.source_cn: 想掌握这项技能，没有任何捷径，只能不断积攒经验。我在风...

say:13:1122202012:1.text: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
say:13:1122202012:1.source_cn: 眼下对你来说，那群偷走红沙棘商队货物的盗匪，就是最好的目标。
say:13:1122202012:1.male: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
say:13:1122202012:1.female: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.

choice_prompt:14:1122202012.text: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
choice_prompt:14:1122202012.source_cn: 眼下对你来说，那群偷走红沙棘商队货物的盗匪，就是最好的目标。
choice_prompt:14:1122202012.male: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
choice_prompt:14:1122202012.female: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.

say:15:1122202014:1.text: Well, bandits who go after caravans are usually well-armed, so they're probably well-known by gun merchants.
say:15:1122202014:1.source_cn: 有能力劫掠商队的盗匪，必定火力强悍，免不了要和枪械商人...

say:16:1122202015:1.text: And as far as I know, there's only one person in the entire Eroded Enclave who deals with guns—<style="highlight">Cyril</style> in Alkali.
say:16:1122202015:1.source_cn: 据我所知，整个风蚀飞地，做这门生意的只有一个人——咸水...

say:17:1122202016:1.text: Cyril's a true merchant. If the price is right, he'll sell anything. But first, you've gotta build trust with him.
say:17:1122202016:1.source_cn: 西里尔是个不折不扣的商人。只要钱到位，他什么都能卖，不...

choice_prompt:18:1122202016.text: Cyril's a true merchant. If the price is right, he'll sell anything. But first, you've gotta build trust with him.
choice_prompt:18:1122202016.source_cn: 西里尔是个不折不扣的商人。只要钱到位，他什么都能卖，不过前提是——得建立一定的信任关系。

say:19:1122202018:1.text: He monopolizes the gun trade. If we can get him on our side, he'll surely have lots to offer!
say:19:1122202018:1.source_cn: 垄断了枪械生意的商人，要是能和我们合作，肯定能提供不少...

say:20:1122202019:1.text: Apart from Cyril, there have also been some new faces at the <style="highlight">horse ranch to the east</style> and a merchant at the <style="highlight">inn on the outskirts</style> who's been bellyaching about getting ripped off by bandits. They might have something worth hearing.

say:21:1122202020:1.text: It'd be great if we could find intel on the <style="highlight">bandit's camp</style> or <style="highlight">missing goods</style> from the Buckthorn Caravan.
say:21:1122202020:1.source_cn: 要是能打探到<style=highlight>盗匪营地...

say:22:1122202021:1.text: I'll have Wildclaw and Grayhorn double-check the information. Here's hoping neither of you lets me down.
say:22:1122202021:1.source_cn: 我会给烈爪和老憨安排同样的任务，这样可以验证情报的准确...

choice:18:0:1.text: You want him as an informant?
choice:18:0:1.male: You want him as an informant?
choice:18:0:1.female: You want him as an informant?

say:24:1122202017:1.text: If you turn him into our informant, I'll foot the bill of course!
say:24:1122202017:1.source_cn: ……你把他变成我们的线人，我自然会付账！
say:24:1122202017:1.male: If you turn him into our informant, I'll foot the bill of course!
say:24:1122202017:1.female: If you turn him into our informant, I'll foot the bill of course!

choice:18:1:2.text: But how will we entice him?
choice:18:1:2.male: But how will we entice him?
choice:18:1:2.female: But how will we entice him?

choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 你知道该上哪打听情报？

say:25:1122202013:1.text: You think I haven't already tried asking them for info? When they were robbed, those merchants were all over the place. Not one of them had any useful info.
say:25:1122202013:1.source_cn: 你以为我没去问过？\n被抢劫的时候，那帮商人都乱成一团...
say:25:1122202013:1.male: You think I haven't already tried asking them for info? When they were robbed, those merchants were all over the place. Not one of them had any useful info.
say:25:1122202013:1.female: You think I haven't already tried asking them for info? When they were robbed, those merchants were all over the place. Not one of them had any useful info.

choice:14:1:2.text: Why not ask the Buckthorn Caravan?
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 为什么不去问问红沙棘商队呢？
choice:14:1:2.male: Why not ask the Buckthorn Caravan?
choice:14:1:2.female: Why not ask the Buckthorn Caravan?

say:26:1122202005:1.text: Ever heard the saying, "Once a member, always a member"?
say:26:1122202005:1.source_cn: 呵，有一句话你听过没？“既然上了贼船，就别想跑了”！
say:26:1122202005:1.male: Ever heard the saying, "Once a member, always a member"?
say:26:1122202005:1.female: Ever heard the saying, "Once a member, always a member"?

say:27:1122202006:1.text: Don't tell me you decided to try out bounty hunting as a hobby?! You gotta take this seriously!
say:27:1122202006:1.source_cn: 这话放在我们身上也很合适——只不过我们是“抓贼的船”。
